mon.title: Live Monitor
mon.note: Scope = my holdings + watchlist + top N of today's signals (max 60). Prices come from an unlicensed public Tencent endpoint with unverified delay and accuracy; personal, small-scale use only. Polling runs during A-share continuous trading only and stops after the close; off by default and must be started manually after a restart. Not investment advice.

mon.status.stats: {used} / {budget} requests used · {count} stocks watched (max {max}) · {rounds} rounds done
mon.status.truncated: The list exceeded the limit and was truncated (holdings first, then watchlist, then signals).

mon.cfg.title: Settings
mon.cfg.top_n: Top N signals (0 to the watch limit)
mon.cfg.hint_provider: Start with a watch limit of 10 and raise it only once it is stable. Batch mode needs easyquotation installed locally and falls back to tencent otherwise. If anything goes wrong, set the data source back to tencent to roll back.
mon.cfg.hint: Each stock is requested at most once per 60 s and requests are at least 10 s apart regardless of this interval; changes apply from the next round.
mon.cfg.err_easy: Switching to easy failed: most often easyquotation is not installed on this machine (or another value is invalid). The data source is unchanged.
mon.status.degraded: Batch mode failed repeatedly and fell back to tencent one-by-one mode. To roll back, choose tencent and save; to retry easy, stop and start again.
mon.status.easy_missing: Batch mode was requested but easyquotation is not installed, so tencent is in use.

usmon.title: US Live Monitor
usmon.note: Scope = US watchlist (max 30; US holdings and signals are empty in this first version). Prices come from Yahoo's unofficial public endpoint via yfinance, with no market-data license and unverified delay and accuracy; personal, small-scale use only; each stock refreshes about every 5 minutes. Polling runs during the US regular session only (Mon-Fri 09:30-16:00 Eastern, i.e. 21:30-04:00 Beijing in summer time and 22:30-05:00 in winter time) and stops after the close; off by default and must be started manually after a restart. There is no holiday calendar; stale quotes are the only holiday signal. Not investment advice.
usmon.ia.note: Updated once per polling round; intraday prices are not closing prices. Everything below is for reference only, not investment advice. US stocks have no daily price limits and no T+1 rule.
usmon.ia.exec.empty: No execution hints (no US signal source yet; holding-drop hints need holdings).
usmon.ia.track.empty: No US signals to track yet.
usmon.ev.display_only: low liquidity (low price or small turnover), display only
usmon.cfg.hint: Each stock is requested at most once per 300 s and requests are at least 10 s apart regardless of this interval; consecutive failures lengthen the wait automatically and rate limiting triggers a 10-minute cooldown; changes apply from the next round.
usmon.q.time_note: All times are US Eastern time (daylight saving handled automatically). Prices are intraday samples, not closing prices, and are never used to recompute strategy signals.
usmon.q.empty: No watched stocks: the US watchlist has no valid symbols (holdings and signals are empty in this version), or monitoring has not started. This is normal, not a fault.
usmon.phase.waiting_session: Waiting for trading hours (US Eastern 09:30–16:00, Mon–Fri)
usmon.phase.cooling_down: Cooling down (requests deferred after a failure or rate limit)
usmon.reason.budget_exhausted: The request budget for this run is used up; start again manually
usmon.reason.quality_error: Three consecutive data-quality failures (possibly a market holiday or stale quotes)
usmon.reason.rate_limited: Upstream rate limit (429); paused to avoid making it worse
usmon.reason.symbol_missing: Three consecutive no-data answers for the symbol
usmon.reason.yfinance_not_installed: yfinance is not installed; cannot poll (install it and start again)
usmon.err.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid input: interval must be an integer 60–3600 and top N an integer 0–30.
